claims.statement: Panasonic NCR18650PD is a bare 18650 cell, approximately 18.6 mm x 65.2 mm; aggregate records identify it as flat-top and unprotected.
Steam Engine preserves Panasonic NCR18650PD 2900mAh 3.4C as a 2900mAh preset with a 3.4C runtime rating.
Panasonic NCR18650PD is identified in academic battery literature as an NCA-family lithium-ion cell.
The exact catalog entry Panasonic NCR18650PD has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2013-06 or earlier.
